title: SIDESTORY: DOSSOLES HOLIDAY RERUN
lines: 01 SIDE STORY: DOSSOLES HOLIDAY RERUN
EVENT DURATION: February 28, 2023, 10:00 (UTC-7) - March 14, 2023, 03:59 (UTC-7)
UNLOCK REQUIREMENT: Clear Main Storyline 1-10
DETAILS: Dossoles Holiday event stages will be open for a limited time. Players can obtain event rewards by clearing event stages, completing the event missions, and redeeming from the event shop.
EVENT STAGES DURATION:
- [Dossoles Warrior Champion]
Duration: February 28, 2023, 10:00 (UTC-7) - March 10, 2023, 03:59 (UTC-7)
- [Tidings Unseen]
Duration: February 28, 2023, 10:00 (UTC-7) - March 10, 2023, 03:59 (UTC-7)
- [Afterwinds]
Duration: February 28, 2023, 10:00 (UTC-7) - March 10, 2023, 03:59 (UTC-7)
[HONORS SHOWCASE]

DETAILS: During the event, players can complete [Ch'en's Clue Note] missions to earn [Miss Ch'en Commemorative Medal]. It can be used to redeem rewards in [Honors Showcase], and unlock commemorative photos as well as hidden stages.
MAIN REWARDS: ★★★★★: Tequila, Coral Coast Collection - Summer Flower FA026 for Sussurro, Stickers, LMD, Elite Materials, etc.
[ MAMA JOHN'S ]
DURATION: February 28, 2023, 10:00 (UTC-7) - March 14, 2023, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, players can obtain [Mama John's Vouchers] by clearing event stages. Mama John's Vouchers can be used to redeem items from [Mama John's].
MAIN REWARDS: Tequila's Token, Dossoles Private Spa Furniture (Pieces), Headhunting Permit, LMD, Furniture Parts, Elite Materials, etc.
NOTE:

- The requirements to obtain certain medals of this event have been updated. Players who have participated in the original event and met the adjusted requirements will receive the corresponding medals once log in.
- Once the rerun ends, the Medal Set of this event can no longer be obtained via any method, including the [Side Story].
- This event rerun will carry on the stage progress and First Clear progress.

- The once-only rewards in the rerun will automatically be converted to Intelligence Certificates for players who have already claimed them. Please refer to [Intelligence Certificate Conversion Rules] for more details.
- [Intelligence Certificate Area] will be restocked as the event rerun begins. In addition, new redeemable will be added.
- Operators Ch'en the Holungday, Mizuki, La Pluma, and Tequila will gain more trust during the event rerun.

- The event stages will be permanently added to the [Side Story] after the end of the event at 04:00 on March 14 (UTC-7). The [Stickers] in the First Clear Reward of the event stages will be replaced with materials and other event rewards; all [Stickers] will be unlocked and can be carried into the event stages.

DURATION: February 28, 2023, 10:00 (UTC-7) - March 14, 2023, 03:59 (UTC-7)

HOW TO OBTAIN:

- Limited-time sale at the Store (Pieces) from February 28, 2023, 10:00 (UTC-7) to March 14, 2023, 03:59 (UTC-7)
